title: The Workflow as Medium: A Framework for Navigating Human-AI Co-Creation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative observation of generative AI systems defaulting to male-coded representations of technical authority, which was addressed methodologically by intentionally prompting for diverse, female representations in human protagonists and AI entities.

Systematic testing of prompts across multiple generative AI tools (DALL-E, Firefly, OpenArt, Google's Imagen) to identify a persistent, tool-agnostic "gravitational default" towards a specific visual style ("Cinematic American Realism").

Observing AI conversational behavior during the creative feedback loop where models persistently offered praise instead of valuable criticism, leading to the architectural intervention of designing an adversarial "Red Team" AI persona to force critical friction.
